item.title: Change Firefox tabs back to square corners
item.description:
How do I change the tabs back to square corners?

Type about:config in the address bar, search for browser.nova.enabled, and double-click it to change its value to false.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1608888

item.title: Push to multiple git remotes with one command
item.description:
Push to multiple git remotes with one command

I keep my main repo on a self-hosted server and mirror it to GitHub. Two remotes, one command.

1. Add the remotes

git remote add aurcade ssh://git@myserver.org:2222/user/repo.git
git remote add github git@github.com:user/repo.git
git remote -v # check

2. Add an alias

In .git/config (this repo only) or ~/.gitconfig (all repos):

[alias]
 pushall = "!git push aurcade && git push github"

Now git pushall pushes to both. The alias even shows up in tab completion.
